events.label: Наука
entries: 1945 – World War II: Hiroshima, Japan is devastated when the atomic bomb "Little Boy" is dropped by the United States B-29 Enola Gay. Around 70,000 people are killed instantly, and some tens of thousands die in subsequent years from burns and radiation poisoning.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1538 – Bogotá, Colombia, is founded by Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada.
1819 – Norwich University is founded in Vermont as the first private military school in the United States.
2001 – Erwadi fire incident: Twenty-eight mentally ill persons tied to a chain are burnt to death at a faith based institution at Erwadi, Tamil Nadu.
